{{Top|leg}}
A '''tally sensor''' was a device used by officers in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to distinguish between their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. It was considered somewhat discourteous, as it was the equivalent of having to read a nametag to address a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] by his name.
